Learn more Top is selected, so you'll see featured comments Comments 13 In this video Chapters Description What Storms Do to Your Roof and How to Fix It | Storm Ready 125Likes4,747ViewsJul 262025 #stormpreparedness #roofrepair #severeweather #diyhomerepair Your roof is your home’s first line of defense during a storm — but most of us don’t really know how it works until something goes wrong. In this episode of Storm Ready, Dylan and Ira break down what actually happens to your roof during severe weather, how to spot the early signs of damage, and how to track down a leak before it causes bigger issues. You’ll learn: How your roof handles wind, rain, and hail The common places leaks begin How to inspect your roof from the ground or attic What to do if you find damage Don’t wait for the next storm to find out your roof has a problem. No matter what type of severe weather you're preparing for, this guide will help you make sure your roof is ready for whatever the weather brings.
